batches.purpose: Build the minimal rootful Podman dependency closure before storage and container execution validation.

packages.notes: Selected initial OCI runtime; runc remains optional.
Podman network engine; CNI bundle omitted from the initial lane.
Registry, policy, seccomp, and containers.conf resources.

batches.purpose: Build a chrooted and deliberately scoped CPython/Flask runtime for the Nginx-fronted MicroBlog MVP.

packages.notes: Scope to interpreter, required stdlib and native extensions; omit Tk, idlelib, test payload, broad database drivers, and scientific packages.
Nginx proxies to loopback Flask with file-backed content; no Redis, PostgreSQL, or RabbitMQ in this batch.
